text:
incident-bot: PAGED: sev2 hosted-api-eu high 5xx rate, routing fallbacks activating. link: https://pager.redwood/4478912345
mike (oncall): On it. Just landed on the host. Seeing repeated model load failures in eu-dedicated pool (eu-ded-1). Errors look like OOM/model-variant mismatch.
jordan (eng): I pushed a model-variant rollout last night (v2-quant). Can confirm some nodes are failing during mmap load. sample log:
```
runtime error: model_mmap: incompatible-quant: expected dtype=float16 got=int8
OOM when allocating 2.1GB for KV cache
```
elaine (sre): Repro with a single request shows immediate 503s from that pool. Topology shows autoscaler spun up 6 new nodes with config tag `quant-deploy`.
mike (oncall): Quick mitigation: changing routing policy to prefer regional fallback to `hosted-us` and marking eu-ded-1 pool draining. Doing now.
mike (oncall): adminctl routes set --service hosted-api --prefer-region us --temp-ttl 1800
jordan (eng): Thanks. I'm retracting v2-quant rollout and queuing rollback to v1-safe on eu pools. Will patch deploy config to avoid autoscaler using `quant-deploy` until we verify.

jordan (eng): Rollback command:
```
deployctl promote --model my-embedder --from v1-safe --to eu-ded-1
```
incident-bot: Note: routing change and drain initiated. Fallbacks in effect. Alert thinning applied.
nina (product): Any initial customer impact? Sam, do we have CS reports?
sam (cs): Seeing 24 tickets in EU region, mostly transient 5xx. A handful of VIP customers hit timeouts (chat features degraded). Noticing retry storms on client side.
elaine (sre): Estimated customer-facing window ~22m peak, ongoing up to 40m while drain finishes. I'll add note to status page.
mike (oncall): Confirmed error-rate back to baseline after routing + rollback. Monitoring for 30m.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: routing fallback and rollback stabilized 5xx. Please create postmortem if impact > 5m or VIP customers affected.
mike (oncall): Handoff to daytime: summary attached below, assigning owners for post-incident follow-up.

--- Handoff summary ---
- Incident ID: 2026-03-eu-4478912345
- Impact: sev2 - hosted-api-eu 5xx surge, VIP timeouts for ~6 customers, peak 22m
- Root cause (initial): autoscaler launched nodes with `quant-deploy` tag that attempted to serve incompatible quantized model variant (v2-quant). Model load failed causing OOM/503s.
- Mitigations taken: 1) Prefer-us routing for hosted-api 2) Drain eu-ded-1 pool 3) Rollback v2-quant -> v1-safe
- Status: Stabilized, monitoring

Action items proposed (create tickets with labels: incident, sev2, q2-reliability):
1) Fix autoscaler tag/config validation - owner: jordan (eng) - estimate: medium (3-5d) - reason: prevent bad pool launches
2) Add deploy canary for quantized variants (small traffic slice + health checks) - owner: jordan (eng) - estimate: small (2d)
3) Add alert for model-load-mismatch metric & OOM spike in pool - owner: elaine (sre) - estimate: small (1-2d)
4) Customer communications template for regional fallback events - owner: sam (cs) - estimate: small (1d)
5) Postmortem doc + meeting - owner: mike (oncall) - estimate: small (prep 2h, meeting 1h)
6) Q2 roadmap tie: include autoscaler config hardening in Reliability epic - owner: nina (product) - priority: P1 for Q2 planning

mike (oncall): I'll create the tickets now and add acceptance criteria. tagging owners.
jordan (eng): I'll start a PR to block autoscaler tags that aren't in allowlist. Putting a draft up today.
elaine (sre): I'll add the metric and a paged alert if OOMs > 5 in 5m for a pool.
sam (cs): I'll draft a short customer-safe blurb and a VIP outreach list.
nina (product): We'll slot the reliability epic into Q2 planning; this maps to OKR RI-1. Prioritizing P1.

mike (oncall): Proposed postmortem meeting: Thu 09:30 UTC. If that's bad, suggest alternatives.
elaine (sre): Works for me.
jordan (eng): Works.
sam (cs): Works.

mike (oncall): Done: created tickets:
- INC-5123 autoscaler-validate-tags (owner: jordan) estimate: 3d
- INC-5124 quant-canary (owner: jordan) estimate: 2d
- INC-5125 oom-alerts-pool (owner: elaine) estimate: 1d
- INC-5126 customer-template-fallback (owner: sam) estimate: 1d
- INC-5127 postmortem-2026-03-eu-4478912345 (owner: mike) estimate: 2h prep

incident-bot: Reminder: add Sev/Impact summary and timeline to INC-5127 doc. Use template: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/template
mike (oncall): Adding timeline now. I'll @nina with the PR to add to Q2 board.

elaine (sre): Quick note: let's also add an e2e smoke test in the deploy pipeline that loads the model in a constrained env to catch dtype mismatch early. tag: infra-testing.
jordan (eng): Good call. Adding to INC-5124 as acceptance criteria.

nina (product): Prioritization: INC-5123 and INC-5124 = P1 for Q2 reliability sprint 1. INC-5125/6 = P2.
sam (cs): I'll prepare customer outreach draft and share in #support-ready for review by EOD.

mike (oncall): Thanks all. If anything new pops, I'll re-open. Otherwise we'll close thread after postmortem is done.

elaine (sre): +1 :thumbsup:
jordan (eng): :rocket:
sam (cs): :hands_clapping:
